title: Publish Promotion Hardening

P-1.implementation: One CommitOperationCopy per file in sorted order; each file gets its own create_commit call

P-2.implementation: Check release_index.json for existing release entry; abort if found

P-3.implementation: Validate source exists, destination path valid, no duplicate destinations, no path collisions before any HF operation

P-4.implementation: Run verify_manifest_files against metadata/checksums.sha256 before any network I/O

P-5.implementation: After copy: verify destination exists, size matches, SHA256 matches; fail on any mismatch

P-6.implementation: If release_index update fails after successful HF copy: emit recovery info, preserve audit log, no destructive cleanup

P-7.implementation: release_index.json updated only after all verification passes; chain hashes preserved from source manifest
